item.title: Pet Brew: How Pet Parenting Reshapes the Economy
item.description:
What's fetch in the business of pets...
Good morning. Today’s issue is all about our furry (or scaly) friends. Keeping our tiny family members happy is a big business, so here in Pet Brew, we’ll take a look at everything from Gen Z’s favorite pets, the high-end pet habitat that might make your home more valuable, the rise of keeping bugs as pets, the popularity of pet psychics, and more. So, sit, stay, read, and enjoy.

item.title: Tokenmaxxed out: Tokenmaxxing and the Dell AI boom
item.description:
Dell is the latest AI winner...
Hi there. It’s time to get cracking on that thing you said you’d only do once in a blue moon, because tomorrow night, we’re getting one. And not just any blue moon, but an even rarer blue micromoon—because it’ll be not only the second full moon this month, but also the most distant full moon of the year (making it look smaller and dimmer). As usual, a blue moon is best enjoyed with an orange slice.

item.title: Heated survivalry: From doomsday bunkers to Meta paywalls
item.description:
CEOs are losing confidence in the US economy...
Happy Friday. Patagonia is suing drag queen environmentalist Pattie Gonia for trademark infringement. “While we wish we didn’t have to do this...it has become necessary to protect the brand,” Patagonia said. In response, Pattie Gonia accused the outdoor apparel company of “trying to erase an activist.”

item.title: Travel Brew: The Death of the Budget Vacation
item.description:
A look at the people goin’ places in this economy…
Good morning. Are you traveling this summer, planning to, or just pretending you are before ultimately curling up on the couch and watch all 12 seasons of Love Island instead? Whatever the case, today’s special edition is all about the latest travel trends. We’ll look at how the industry is increasingly geared toward high-income consumers, give you the latest on the chic luggage race, recommend some off-the-beaten-path destinations, and much more.
